home.subtitle: The ultimate private PDF toolkit. Select a tool to begin.
home.privacyDesc: TooBee PDF Studio processes everything directly in your browser. Your sensitive documents never touch our servers, ensuring 100% privacy and security.

tools.splitDesc: Break a PDF into separate files.
tools.compressDesc: Reduce file size for easier sharing.
tools.extractFolderDesc: Split every page into its own PDF and download as a ZIP.
tools.protectDesc: Encrypt your document with an AES-256 password.
tools.unlockDesc: Remove password protection and export freely.

home.headline: Every PDF tool, on this machine.
home.mastheadSub: Nothing is uploaded and nothing leaves the machine. Pick a tool to start.

settings.title: Settings
settings.perfFullHint: Everything on. Best on a modern machine.
settings.perfLightHint: Renders fewer page thumbnails up front.
settings.perfMinimalHint: No animations at all. For older, slower computers.

common.dropzoneSubtitle: Click to browse or drag and drop your files here. Supported formats: PDF, Images, Word, Excel, Text, CSV, RTF, Markdown, HTML.

merge.title: Merge Files
merge.desc: Combine multiple files (PDFs, Images, Office Docs, Text) into a single, cohesive PDF.
merge.preview: Add files to see the preview
merge.fail: Failed to merge files. Ensure they are valid.

protect.errAlready: This PDF already has a password. Remove it with Unlock PDF first.
protect.errPwChar: That password contains a character that cannot be used in a PDF password. Please choose a different one.
protect.errPwUnstable: That password contains a character that PDF readers treat inconsistently, so the file might not open again. Please choose a different one.
protect.errPwBidi: That password mixes right-to-left and left-to-right text, which the PDF standard does not allow. Please use a single text direction.
protect.errFail: Could not protect this PDF. It may be damaged.
protect.title: Protect
protect.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
protect.errUnsupported: That file type is not supported.
protect.pwTruncated: Shortened to the {{max}}-byte limit that PDF passwords allow.

perf.hint: This machine may run better in Light mode.

sign.title: Sign
sign.name: Name
sign.importHint: Crop it, lift it off the paper, then click the page to place it.
sign.flipTextNote: Typed signatures stay as real text in the PDF, so they can be turned but not mirrored. Draw or import one to flip it.
sign.libraryEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Build a signature above and choose Save for reuse.
sign.notPersistent: Running outside the desktop app, so saved signatures last only until this window closes.
sign.placeHint: Click the page to place it.
sign.buildHint: Build a signature above, then click the page to place it.
sign.errApply: The signatures could not be applied.

import.panHint: Scroll to zoom · Alt-drag or middle-drag to pan
import.errRead: That file could not be read as an image.
import.errProcess: That image could not be processed.

cutout.featherHelp: How gradually the cut fades out at the edge of the ink. Raise it to soften a hard, cut-out outline.

threshold.label: Brightness
threshold.blurb: Drops every pixel lighter than the cutoff. Best for dark ink on white paper.
threshold.toleranceHelp: How light a pixel may be before it counts as paper and is erased. Raise it if parts of the signature disappear; lower it if grey paper is left behind.

flood.label: Edge colour
flood.blurb: Samples the four corners and spreads inward. Keeps dark areas enclosed by the ink.
flood.toleranceHelp: How far a colour may drift from the corner colour and still count as background. Raise it for uneven or shadowed paper; lower it if the ink is being eaten away.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.blurb: Runs a segmentation model on this machine. Handles any subject, but is much slower.

fonts.denied: Installed fonts could not be read. Upload a font file with +.

edit.title: Studio editor
edit.emptyLayers: Click the page to add a text box.
edit.hintShape: Click a shape to select and edit it.
edit.hintPoints: Click the page to place points, then close the shape.

convert.title: PDF to image
convert.resolutionHint: High doubles the file size of each image.
convert.errConvert: Could not convert this PDF. It may be encrypted or damaged.

compress.title: Compress
compress.simpleHint: Lossless structural cleanup. Fast, and safe for any document.
compress.aggressiveHint: Rebuilds the file to strip every unused object. Largest reduction.

split.title: Split
split.rangeHint: Use commas for single pages and a dash for a run, like 1-3, 5.
split.errNoPages: No pages matched. Check the page ranges.
split.errFailed: Split failed. Check the page ranges.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.nothingToRemove: This PDF is not protected, so there is nothing to remove.
unlock.errPassword: That password did not work. Try again.

rotate.title: Rotate & reorder
rotate.dragHint: Drag a page to move it, or use the arrows under each one.

extractFolder.title: Extract to folder
extractFolder.emptyHeadline: Split into one file per page
extractFolder.errRead: Could not read this PDF. It may be encrypted or corrupted.
